# P4 · Billing, care follow-up and patient portal — R4 · Clinic Ops

**Window:** Weeks 17–26 · 15 Feb 2027 → 23 Apr 2027  
**Delivered to:** Clinic owners and admins, care coordinators and the clinics’ patients  
**Day one:** Bill and collect payment, close the cash drawer, track every result and follow-up to closure, and let patients book and see their records.  
**Goal:** The clinic runs its money and its follow-ups in Medvya, and patients can serve themselves.

**Tickets:** 33 · **Estimate:** 72.5 dev-days vs **50 working days** in the window (OVER by 22.5 days: needs scope trade-off or overlap) · **Average confidence:** 79%

**Status:** To do 32 · Done 1

## Epics

| Epic | Title | Requirements | Goal |
|---|---|---|---|
| MDV-P4-E01 | Services, invoicing and documents | P4-01, P4-02 | Country-correct price lists, invoices, receipts, credit notes and legal numbering. |
| MDV-P4-E02 | Payments, packages, dues and day close | P4-03, P4-04 | Collect money safely, track dues and packages, and close the drawer with zero unexplained variance. |
| MDV-P4-E03 | Closed-loop results and care | P4-05, P4-06 | Every result and follow-up is owned, reviewed and closed with evidence; a sent message never closes care. |

## Exit criteria (release gate)

- [ ] Cash close balances with zero unexplained variance for 10 consecutive days — [MDV-P4-012](MDV-P4-012.md), [MDV-P4-033](MDV-P4-033.md)
- [ ] Invoice formats reviewed by a chartered accountant (India) / tax adviser (UAE) — [MDV-P4-005](MDV-P4-005.md), [MDV-P4-031](MDV-P4-031.md), [MDV-P4-033](MDV-P4-033.md)

- [ ] ≥ 30% of bookings confirmed by patients via portal or WhatsApp — [MDV-P4-023](MDV-P4-023.md), [MDV-P4-028](MDV-P4-028.md), [MDV-P4-033](MDV-P4-033.md)
